fields.label: Fonts to get
fields.hint: The catalog Get fonts lists: FrameOS's, or one of your own in its format (docs/esp32-fonts.md).

fonts.name: Fonts
fonts.description: The fonts this frame has, a page at a time with each name in its own face, a specimen of the one you pick, and Get fonts: a catalog of fonts (Google Fonts and FrameOS's own) the frame downloads into its fonts folder by itself. On an ESP32 the fonts are the ones on its SD card, each read where it lies.
